title: Curriculum vitae
Research
text:
Assistive robotics · Physical human-robot interaction · Wearable robotics
I design clinically validated systems that sense human intent from wearable sensors (EMG, IMU) and turn it into real-time robotic assistance — powered exoskeletons, actuated ankle-foot orthoses, and functional electrical stimulation. My current interests include physics-based modeling, model-based control, and multimodal AI for understanding and predicting human motion.
